title: How Managers Make Decisions | Principles of Management Ep 21
description:
How do good managers pick the right option instead of guessing? Chai Corner now has five outlets and a small head office, and on winter evenings sales drop at all five. Kabir wants hot snacks, Asha wants longer hours and Meena wants a new flavour. Ravi needs a way to choose.

You will learn what decision making means (choosing the best option from two or more alternatives) and the 7 steps of the decision-making process: identify the problem, gather information, identify alternatives, evaluate them, choose the best, implement, and follow up. We also see why follow up matters: one month later, one outlet still needs a fix, so the loop starts again.

This is Episode 21 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 Five outlets, one winter problem
0:23 What is decision making?
0:39 The 7 steps of decision making
1:24 Follow up and the decision loop
1:40 Quick check
1:52 Recap

Next episode: Programmed and Non-Programmed Decisions.
